experimental.annotationsAllFormatsHint: Enables highlight/comment UI on TXT, Markdown, and EPUB documents. Persisted anchors aren't reflow-aware yet, so highlights may drift after edits.
experimental.whiteboardAllFormatsHint: Enables draw mode and whiteboard creation on non-paginated documents. Whiteboards anchor to pages, so behavior may be unpredictable on reflowable content.

about.title: About Pnyxy
about.p1: Pnyxy is a modern, multi-format reading app. It supports PDF, EPUB, Markdown, and plain-text documents, with annotation, whiteboard, and search tooling built in.
about.p2: The project is built around an extensible plugin system and a themeable UI. Your library lives locally by default; cloud sync is optional.
about.p3: Have feedback or want to contribute? Reach out via the links in the footer.

opening.heading: Opening a document
opening.body: Drop a file into the Library or use the upload button. PDF, EPUB, Markdown, and plain-text files are all supported.
